card.name: Inside CYP enzyme and metabolizing phrases
card.fires_on: Words partway through enzyme phrases in drug-metabolism text, such as isozyme, metabolizing, and the CYP2D6 name. It also fires on small words next to CYP enzymes.

modes.label: Enzyme names and terms
modes.description: Parts of the words isozyme, metabolizing, or CYP2D6 itself, in P450 interaction text.
modes.example: the drug metabol<<izing>> isozyme cytochrome P4

modes.label: Words next to CYP enzymes
modes.description: Small words such as 'to' or 'inhibition' right after a CYP enzyme is named.
modes.example: CYP1A2 is known<< to>> be induced by smoking
